Our Framework

Project Lifecycle Phases

A structured three-phase approach that ensures every project is delivered with full governance.

P1

Initiation & Planning

  • Project charter definition
  • Stakeholder identification
  • Scope of work finalisation
  • Risk register preparation
  • Resource & budget planning
P2

Execution & Monitoring

  • Team deployment & coordination
  • Daily/weekly progress tracking
  • Issue & change management
  • Quality assurance checkpoints
  • Stakeholder communication
P3

Delivery & Closure

  • Acceptance testing (UAT)
  • As-built documentation
  • Staff handover & training
  • Lessons-learned review
  • Post-implementation support
Our Services

What We Manage For You

Comprehensive project management services covering every dimension of your ICT project.

Scope & Timeline Management

Detailed work-breakdown structure, Gantt scheduling, critical-path analysis and proactive milestone tracking to keep projects on track.

Budget Control & Reporting

Cost-baseline setting, variance analysis, procurement oversight and transparent reporting to stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder Engagement

Structured RACI matrices, communication plans, executive briefings and client-facing dashboards that keep everyone aligned and informed.

Risk & Issue Management

Proactive risk identification, probability-impact scoring, mitigation planning and issue escalation frameworks to protect project success.

Quality Assurance

Inspection checklists, test-acceptance criteria, standards compliance reviews and corrective-action management at every stage.

Compliance & Governance

Alignment with government procurement regulations, ICT security policies, MAMPU guidelines and client-specific governance frameworks.
